column3: NASB renders “fragrant oil” as “ointment” and adds “It was.”
NASB adds “word”; the imperfect “was being sick” is rendered “is sick.”
NASB renders “unto death” as “to end in death.”
NASB recasts the question (“are You going there again?”).
NASB follows the critical text; “get well” is rendered “recover.”
NASB renders “the rest of sleep” as “literal sleep.”
NASB follows the critical text; “met with” is rendered “went to meet,” and “was sitting” is “stayed.”
NASB follows the critical text without “Nevertheless.”
